description: Discover which TensorFeed endpoint answers a data need. Describe what you want in plain language (e.g. "trending AI papers", "is OpenAI down", "model price history") and this returns the 2 to 3 best-matching TensorFeed endpoints, each with its HTTP path, what it returns, and whether it is free or paid. TensorFeed exposes 100+ AI-ecosystem data and signed-verdict endpoints; the core ones are also dedicated tools, but the full catalog is reachable here and callable over HTTP (paid ones via x402 or a credits token). On this server it also matches tools that are callable by name but not listed (openFDA, EIA energy series, SEC company submissions, and more). Free, no auth. Use this first when no dedicated tool obviously fits.

limit.description: Max endpoints to return (1 to 5, default 3).

query.description: Plain-language description of the data or decision you need.

name: find_tensorfeed_data
